subject: SOC2 evidence batch — handoff, retention window, and term flexibility
messages:
From: maya.lopez@brightsidehealth.com
To: logan.wright@redwood.com
Cc: tom.chen@brightsidehealth.com
Date: 2028-07-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: SOC2 evidence batch + retention window for renewal

Hi Logan —

Were in the middle of Brightsides annual vendor recert process and Redwood is on the short list. Our security team has a few asks to close the loop for our procurement team:

1) A manifest of evidentiary artifacts we can pull into our audit repository (CSV preferred).
2) Confirmation of current log retention windows (auth, admin, API request logs) and any planned changes through the next 12 months.
3) A single point of contact for bulk upload access (S3 or secure Share Link) so our internal auditors can retrieve artifacts during our cert window.

Were also evaluating a modest capacity increase and a 12→24 month term extension tied to the recert outcome. Procurement (Tom) will need any term-flex language you can provide so we can prepare a change order early in the renewal cycle.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: provide the CSV manifest, share retention SLAs, and create a temporary read-only bucket with time-limited credentials?

Thanks — I can be flexible on times for a short sync this week.

— Maya Lopez
Senior Information Security Manager
Brightside Health

(attachment: request-template.xlsx)

From: logan.wright@redwood.com
To: maya.lopez@brightsidehealth.com
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-21T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence batch + retention window for renewal

Hi Maya —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can support all three items and Ill coordinate the handoff. Quick plan: 

- Ill attach a CSV manifest with the canonical artifact names and timestamps (auth, admin, API, audit exports).
- Grace will confirm the retention windows and our standard uplift options (e.g., 90/180/365 day retention plans) and note any implications for export size.
- Marissa will provision a secure, read-only S3 bucket + pre-signed urls for your auditors and provide the ACL/TTL.

On the commercial side: we can offer a term-flex change order that ties a 20% reserved capacity uplift to a 24-month commitment; alternatively we can do a 12-month addendum with a shorter notice for scale. Ill loop Procurement language for Tom to review.

Im out at customer Q&A until 11:30 PT but can jump on a 30m call this afternoon if useful.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

(attachments: evidence_manifest.csv)

From: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
To: logan.wright@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-22T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence batch + retention window for renewal

Thanks Logan —

Retention detail draft below (sending summary; we will attach a PDF proposal):

- Auth logs: retained 180 days by default; optional 365 days on Dedicated/Private SKUs (additional storage fee applies).
- Admin/console audit trail: 365 days (immutable snapshot available for export).
- API request logs: default 90 days; can be extended to 180 or 365 with a configuration change; extension increases export sizes and may require a brief ingest-hold during the bucket export window.

Notes: If Brightside wants a guaranteed extended window in contract (e.g., 365 days), we recommend the Dedicated uplift because it simplifies SLA and storage predictability. Ill prepare a short matrix mapping retention window → expected export footprint.

Also flagged a potential SOC2 doc update: we recently consolidated our log archival encryption key handling (KMS integration) — Marissa, please confirm the audit trail for key rotation that Maya asked about.

- Grace
Grace OConnor
Manager, Compliance & Observability
Redwood Inference

(attachment: log-retention-proposal-2028-07.pdf)

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: maya.lopez@brightsidehealth.com
Cc: logan.wright@redwood.com, tom.chen@brightsidehealth.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-24T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Secure upload & evidence manifest delivery

Hi Maya / Tom —

Per Logan and Grace, Ive provisioned a read-only S3 bucket for your auditors and uploaded the initial package. Details below:

- Bucket: s3://redwood-evidence/brightside-hs74920 (read-only, access TTL 72 hrs)
- Manifest: evidence_manifest.csv (contains artifact id, path in bucket, generated_at UTC)
- Gap matrix: redwood-soc2-gap-matrix.xlsx (high-level mapping to SOC2 controls)

Pre-signed link (expires in 72 hrs): https://s3.redwood.com/pre-signed/brightside-hs74920/initial (shared via secure channel)

Marissa also attached the log-retention proposal and the KMS rotation audit we reference. If youd like us to stage additional export slices (e.g., a scoped API-log segment for only May–June 2028), say the window and well queue it; note that large slices may take up to 48 hours to land due to secure export throttling.

Commercial proposal: Logan and I prepared a short term-flex addendum for Toms review: 20% reserved capacity uplift for a 24-month term, 10% uplift for a 12-month add-on. I attached the change-order word doc (we can send through DocuSign).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

(attachments: redwood-soc2-gap-matrix.xlsx, doc-change-order-20pct.docx)

From: tom.chen@brightsidehealth.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, logan.wright@redwood.com, maya.lopez@brightsidehealth.com
Date: 2028-07-25T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Secure upload & evidence manifest delivery

Marissa / Logan —

Received the bucket and reviewed the manifest. Clean handoff — thank you. A couple quick asks before we close: 

- Can you add DocuSign-ready wording that ties the 20% uplift to the 24-month term and clarifies rollback triggers (e.g., 15-day notice for scale-down)?
- Confirm the SLA credit language if the retention export window is delayed beyond 72 hrs (our auditors flag time-to-evidence).

If you can send the DocuSign link and the short SLA paragraph today, Procurement will circulate for internal approval and well target signatures by Aug 2. Were leaning toward the 24-month uplift contingent on the retention guarantees.

Thanks — Tom
Tom Chen
Director, Procurement
Brightside Health

(attachment: procurement-internal-checklist.pdf)
